A template's help

Source: R/tpl_help.R
tfl_tpl_help.Rd

Prints a registered template's parameters by tier: each one's value that takes effect, where it is from (the study standard, a variant, the template) and what it is. A report's argument wins over all of them.

Usage

tfl_tpl_help(
  name,
  study = NULL,
  population = NULL,
  tier = c("required", "usual", "other")
)

Arguments

name

The template's name ("demog").

study

The study standard: a tfl_read_study_spec() object or a study's spec folder; NULL for none (the study column is then NA). Its defaults.yml content is where a parameter's "<verb>.<argument>" source is read, study.yml's settings: treatment: the by ("settings.treatment").

population

The report's analysis set: the value of the parameters taken from the report's population: ("output.population"); NULL for none.

tier

The tiers to print: "required", "usual", "other" (all by default; c("required", "usual") folds the others away).

Value

tfl_tpl_args()(name, study, population), invisibly.

See also

tfl_tpl(); the template's page, ?tfl_tpl_<name> (?tfl_tpl_demog).

Examples

tfl_tpl_help("demog", tier = c("required", "usual"))
#> demog (table, layout summary; variant of summary; tflspec)
#> Demographics
#> Call: tfl_tpl(ard, "demog", ...)
#> 
#> required (1):
#>   param      | effective (layer) | what
#>   population | - (template)      | the analysis set's id (SAF)
#> 
#> usual (6):
#>   param       | effective (layer)                                                            | what
#>   by          | TRT01A (template)                                                            | the column variable
#>   continuous  | AGE (variant:demog)                                                          | the continuous variables, in order
#>   categorical | AGEGR1, SEX, RACE, ETHNIC (variant:demog)                                    | the categorical variables, in order
#>   labels      | AGE = Age (years); AGEGR1 = Age group, n (%); SEX = Sex, ... (variant:demog) | each variable's heading; given by name, merged (RACE: ~ drops one)
#>   cells       | n = {N:.0f}; Mean (SD) = {mean:.1f} ({sd:.2f}); Median = ... (template)      | the rows of each continuous variable
#>   total       | FALSE (template)                                                             | TRUE: a Total column (each analysis again without `by`, plan_total())
